S, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER 1.

Accused Nos.1 to 7 in Crime No.351/2024 registered by Bidadi Police Station, Ramanagara, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 323, 114 and 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, are before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.351/2024 was registered by Bidadi Police Station, Ramanagara, against the petitioners herein for the aforesaid offences on the basis of the first information dated 09.09.2024 received from Divya R, who is the wife of petitioner No.1 herein.
Apprehending arrest in the said case, petitioners had filed Crl.Misc.No.797/2024 before the jurisdictional Sessions Court which was rejected on 19.09.2024.
Therefore, they are before this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that omnibus allegations are made against all the accused persons.
The alleged last incident had taken place on 25.03.2024.
First information was submitted on 09.09.2024.
There is inordinate delay in submitting the first information.
The maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment for a period of three years.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

sentences.text: 6. The material on record would go to show that there is some matrimonial dispute between accused No.1 and his wife.
In the first information that was submitted on 09.09.2024, omnibus allegations have been made against all the accused persons.
The last incident where first informant was abused and sent to her parents house had taken place on 25.03.2024.
First information is belatedly lodged on 09.09.2024.
No proper explanation has been given to the inordinate delay.

Undisputedly,
petitioners have no criminal antecedents.
The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment NC: 2024:KHC:40335 for a period of three years.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that petitioners have made out a prima facie case for grant of anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, the following order:-
7. The petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.351/2024 registered by Bidadi Police Station, Ramanagara, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 323, 114 and 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, subject to the following conditions:
1. The Petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- each with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. Petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.

3. Petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and they shall co-operate with NC: 2024:KHC:40335 the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.
4. The petitioners shall not involve in similar offences in future;
SD/-
(S VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE DN Naveen.
